case_name: The Managing Director K.S.R.T.C. vs Bharathi M.R.
author: Uday Umesh Lalit

paragraphs.text:
O R D E R
Delay of 43 days in preferring Review Petition is condoned.
The compensation granted by the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal in

the amount as aforesaid was arrived at.
We have gone through the grounds taken in the Review Petition and do

not find any error apparent on record to justify interference.
This Review Petition is dismissed.
…………………………J.
 [Uday Umesh Lalit]
